name: statusline
description: One short line for Claude Code's status line: what needs the user, the box, the assistant.

tips.text: Put Vyre's line under every Claude Code session with `vyre statusline install`. It asks before it edits anything.
The line reads `vyre · 2 need you · box ok · juno idle`: what waits on you, your box, and your assistant.
Keep your own status line and add Vyre's under it with `vyre statusline install --chain`.
`vyre statusline uninstall` takes Vyre's line out and puts yours back.
`box away` in the line means this Mac is paired but cannot reach your box right now.
An empty status line means vyred is not running. Run `vyre up` to bring it back.
Install keeps your old Claude Code settings as `settings.json.vyre-backup` beside the file.
